en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2815 - Ibn Maskan narrated from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, who reported from Imam Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who converts to Islam and intends to undergo circumcision while the time for Hajj has arrived.

He asked: Should he perform Hajj or undergo circumcision?
Imam (as) replied: "He should not perform Hajj until he is circumcised."
